issues.description: Return type mismatch for messageOnMilk(): The problem statement (UML and Part 2 description) specifies that messageOnMilk() should return a String (e.g. "[Animal Type] [name] is milked") and the template Main prints the returned value as a String. However, the solution repository defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return boolean (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Milkable.java) and the Seal/Goat implementations print the milking message and return a boolean. This contradicts the specification and will confuse students: they will implement messageOnMilk() to return a String, but the provided solution/reference uses a boolean, and automated tests or usage that expect a String will fail or behave unexpectedly.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Milkable interface and its implementations consistent with the problem statement: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String. Update Seal and Goat to return the milking message string (e.g. return "Seal " + getName() + " is milked";) instead of printing and returning boolean. Ensure Main and any tests print or use the returned String. Alternatively (less recommended), adjust the problem statement and UML to specify a boolean return and describe the boolean behaviour — but keeping the method returning String aligns with the UML and Part 2 textual requirements and is the preferred correction.

issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual instructions) and the template expect Milkable.messageOnMilk() to be a String-returning method that yields the text "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (used via System.out.println in Main). The solution repository instead defines Milkable.messageOnMilk() with a boolean return type and implementations print the message and return true. This is a signature / return-type mismatch for the same conceptual method and will confuse students (they are told to implement/consume a String-returning method but the reference solution uses boolean), and tests or template usage that print the returned value will not align with the solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the solution match the problem/template contract: change Milkable.messageOnMilk() to return String (signature: String messageOnMilk()), and update implementations (Goat, Seal) to return the formatted message: "[Animal Type] [name] is milked" (e.g. return "Goat " + getName() + " is milked"). Remove the System.out.println side-effect and return the string so calls like System.out.println(m.messageOnMilk()) in Main and other template/test code behave consistently.
